title: Origins: Ender Goblin
description: Adds the Ender Goblin to the Origins mod
body:
# About
Ender Goblins have been tainted by the eldritch. They are smaller and weaker but with a few more... oddities, to go along with it.

# Powers
- **Despise Water:** You take damage and randomly teleport when coming in contact with water.
- **Frail:** You have 4 less hearts.
- **Lucky:** You are naturally more lucky then others.
- **Pumpkin Blindness:** You cannot see anything that is wearing a carved pumpkin on its head.
- **Size:** You are approximately one block tall.
- **Throw Ender Pearl:** You can freely throw ender pearls to teleport to wherever the pearl lands.
- **Weak:** You deal reduced damage with melee attacks.

# Dependencies
This pack requires the following mods in order to function properly:
- [Origins](https://modrinth.com/mod/origins) OR [Origins (Forge)](https://modrinth.com/mod/origins-forge)
- [Pehkui](https://modrinth.com/mod/pehkui)
